catalogRulesUsed.semantics: typical peak band only, not Week 1 floor

firstWeekVolumeRule.validPositiveRecentVolume: RUNTIME_USER_DERIVED anchor, not raised to typical peak band minimum

peakVolumeRule.selectedPeak: reachable peak from starting volume and cycle length, capped at 42

weeklyVolumeCurveRule.nonTaper: linear interpolation from starting volume to selected reachable peak across actual non-taper weeks

recoveryAndDeloadRule.behavior: no recurring recovery/deload week invented; taper remains separate

longRunAnchorRule.validRecentLongestRun: anchor reconciled with weekly-volume compatibility, may start below reported maximum
longRunAnchorRule.missing: requires canonical source if paired with missing/zero weekly volume; otherwise weekly-volume-derived
longRunAnchorRule.explicitZero: weekly-volume-derived when weekly volume is valid
longRunAnchorRule.inconsistent: input preserved; state INCONSISTENT; LOW_CONFIDENCE_CONSERVATIVE_CLAMP; weekly-volume-derived

roundingRule.timing: after each weekly and long-run value calculation

decisionTraceSummary: WeeklyVolumeDecisionTrace records reported volume, input state, anchor, unclamped value, typical band, clamp, selected peak, phase, prior week, change rule, taper/recovery rule, rounding, final value.

LongRunDecisionTrace records reported longest run, input state, anchor, low-confidence flag, weekly compatibility, preferred range, hard cap, clamp, prior long run, progression, taper, rounding, final value.
